news.headline: Delcath Systems: Intriguingly Poised Ahead Of Q3 Earnings
news.summary: A Seeking Alpha preview argues Delcath looks attractively positioned into its November 9 Q3 report after the October share-price decline. Data providers put Q3 revenue consensus near $26M, and the report will test whether HEPZATO growth is tracking the $104M-$108M full-year guide.

news.headline: Delcath to Participate in UBS, Canaccord Genuity and Craig-Hallum Investor Conferences in November
news.summary: Management will attend the UBS Global Healthcare Conference (November 10, Palm Beach Gardens, with a live webcast), the Canaccord Genuity MedTech, Diagnostics and Digital Health Forum (November 11, New York) and the Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference (November 17, New York). The appearances follow directly on the November 9 Q3 report, giving management an immediate platform to discuss results and guidance.

news.headline: BlackRock Reports 6.3% Passive Stake in Delcath (Schedule 13G)
news.summary: BlackRock Portfolio Management reported beneficial ownership of 2,180,493 Delcath shares, or 6.3% of the class as of September 30, 2026. That is up from the 1,836,121 shares (5.3%) BlackRock disclosed in July, so a large passive holder kept adding during the Q3 pullback.

news.headline: Delcath to Host Q3 2026 Earnings Call on November 9
news.summary: Delcath will report results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and hold a conference call and webcast on Monday, November 9, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET. The date is later than the November 3-5 window data providers had estimated, and the notice came without preliminary revenue figures.

news.headline: Delcath Highlights ESMO 2026 Presentations (DELUMA, mCRC Update) and Independent Uveal Melanoma Data
news.summary: Delcath will show a DELUMA breast cancer Phase 2 trial-in-progress poster and host a 'Meet the Investigators' session on the Del-Liver mCRC and DELUMA trials at ESMO in Madrid on October 24, alongside an independent Dutch registry poster comparing PHP plus ipilimumab/nivolumab with tebentafusp. A separate independent Southampton/Dublin CHEMOSAT cohort (n=12) in uveal melanoma reported a 66.7% response rate, 18.4-month median hepatic PFS and 28-month median OS.

news.headline: Nebraska Medicine Begins Offering HEPZATO Liver-Directed Therapy for Metastatic Uveal Melanoma
news.summary: Local coverage reports that Nebraska Medicine in Omaha now offers the new liver-directed treatment for patients whose eye cancer (uveal melanoma) has spread to the liver. It adds another academic center in the Midwest to the HEPZATO KIT network that Delcath aims to expand to about 37 active sites by year-end.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 results and call (Nov 9, 8:30 a.m. ET)
catalysts.detail: Delcath announced on October 26 that it will report Q3 2026 results and host a call on Monday, November 9 at 8:30 a.m. ET. Consensus sits near $26.0M revenue and an EPS loss of about $0.09 (TradingView), and options were pricing a move of roughly +/-17%. The call is the first check on whether HEPZATO volumes and center activations are tracking the raised $104M-$108M FY guidance, whether that range gets lifted again, and whether operating leverage shows through after the 340B pricing and spending concerns raised in September commentary.

catalysts.label: UBS Global Healthcare Conference presentation (webcast)
catalysts.detail: Management presents at UBS on November 10 in Palm Beach Gardens, the day after Q3 results, followed by the Canaccord Genuity forum on November 11 and Craig-Hallum Alpha Select on November 17 in New York. The webcast UBS session is the first post-earnings venue for color on center activations, the 2026 guidance and the mCRC/DELUMA trials.

catalysts.label: ~37 active HEPZATO treatment centers, incl. MD Anderson and Mayo Clinic Scottsdale
catalysts.detail: Delcath exited Q2 with 31 active HEPZATO KIT centers and guided to roughly six additional activations by year-end for about 37. Named additions include MD Anderson, Mayo Clinic Scottsdale, UT Southwestern, OHSU Knight Cancer Institute and Columbia's Herbert Irving Comprehensive Cancer Center; UVA Health came online in July. Center count is the most direct driver of near-term revenue, and the September inducement grants for four new hires point to continued commercial staffing behind the build-out.

catalysts.label: FY2026 revenue $104M-$108M and positive adjusted EBITDA
catalysts.detail: Raised guidance implies at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth over 2025, with FY gross margin guided to 86%-89% after Q2 printed 90%. Positive full-year adjusted EBITDA would confirm a self-funding commercial model and, with $95.9M of cash and no debt, remove the dilution overhang that has historically capped the multiple.

catalysts.label: mCRC Phase 2 enrollment progress
catalysts.detail: The company-sponsored Phase 2 of HEPZATO plus trifluridine-tipiracil and bevacizumab versus that regimen alone in third-line liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer had 13 centers actively screening as of the Q2 call, with recruitment improving. Enrollment milestones and eventual data would open by far the largest indication in the pipeline, since liver-dominant mCRC dwarfs uveal melanoma in patient numbers.

catalysts.label: DELUMA breast cancer Phase 2 enrollment and data
catalysts.detail: The roughly 90-patient randomized Phase 2 in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (PHP-MBC-202, NCT06875128) dosed its first patient in July 2026 at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan and is enrolling across more than 20 US and European sites. Investigator-led retrospective data presented at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 showed a 60% hepatic partial response rate in heavily pretreated patients, which underpins the trial's thesis. The primary endpoint is hepatic progression-free survival; full enrollment and first efficacy readouts are the next major pipeline catalysts beyond uveal melanoma.

pulse: As of November 8, 2026, Delcath has issued no new company news since its October 26-27 notices on the Q3 earnings date and November investor conferences; weekend coverage is limited to earnings previews pointing to Q3 revenue near $26M and an EPS loss of about $0.09, with Canaccord reiterating Buy ($21 target) and BlackRock's passive stake up to 6.3%. Shares sit around $14 after an October decline, so sentiment hinges on the Q3 report and call on Monday, November 9 at 8:30 a.m. ET, followed by UBS (Nov 10, webcast), Canaccord (Nov 11) and Craig-Hallum (Nov 17), where investors want a reaffirmed or raised $104M-$108M FY guide and progress toward about 37 active centers.
